text:
Priya: Quick design check — I pushed a small update to the policy canvas in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/policy-canvas. Main asks: stack behavior on narrow widths, how we surface rule conflicts, and microcopy for the preview log. Can folks skim?
Carla: Looking. First glance: the stacked rules feel dense on mobile. Recommend a compressible stack (collapse to a single-line summary) and a visible conflict badge that meets AA. Also conflict copy reads too technical.
Liam: Keyboard/navigation notes: when a rule is moved up/down focus must stay on that rule. Support arrow + space to toggle enable/disable. Conflict alerts should be announced via aria-live.
Evan: From infra side — reorders call the backend. Suggest optimistic UI + debounce (300ms) and an undo toast if the server rejects. If we animate reorder, keep it cheap (no layout thrash).
Anya: I like the timeline scrubber idea for the preview. Could we add a tiny step animation (70–120ms) so stepping between states feels less jarring? I'll mock it.
Carla: Microcopy tweak suggestion: instead of 'mutation rejected by higher priority rule' use 'This rule will not run because a higher rule handles the request.' Or shorter: 'Superseded by higher rule.' Feels clearer to customers.
Liam: Proposed inline validation payloads (two versions):
```
- Verbose: "Rule conflict: Rule 3 conflicts with Rule 1 — it will not run. Select an action: [Drop | Reroute | Escalate]."
- Short: "Superseded by Rule 1 — no action taken."
```
Which do we want in preview logs vs inline badges?
Evan: We should use the short form in-line and keep verbose in the preview log expandable detail. Also will add a server-side field "conflict_hint" so UI can decide. I'll add a feature flag for optimistic reorder.
Priya: @Liam @Evan can we get a quick keyboard prototype + optimistic reorder toggle by Wednesday?
design-bot: Accessibility scan result (quick): conflict-badge color contrast 2.8:1 — fail. Recommendation: increase contrast or add a distinct shape/icon + aria-label.
Evan: Noted. I'll surface contrast as a hard constraint in the CSS tokens and add an undo toast with the payload for rollback. Also will include a preview log entry when reorder fails.
Liam: For focus ring use 3px outline #2563eb and ensure it remains visible inside card backgrounds. Also make drag handles keyboard-focusable with aria-pressed state.
Anya: :thumbsup: I'll produce a 3–4 frame GIF for the scrubber and a compact-stack mock for mobile.
Carla: One more copy nudge — change button text 'Resolve' to 'Choose action' when conflict modal appears. Slightly clearer.
Priya: Great. Summary: adopt Carla's shorter conflict copy inline, verbose in preview details; implement optimistic reorder + undo toast; keyboard focus + aria-live for alerts; design to deliver scrubber GIF and compact stack mocks. Follow-up sync Friday 11:00am. Thanks everyone!
